title: Compact the closed months
prompt: The invoice archive is partitioned by month, and the job that compacts the closed months fails before it compacts anything. Fix `compact_closed_months` so it compacts every month before 2026 and leaves the rest alone.
rules: Compact every month before January 2026 into as few files as OPTIMIZE makes.
Leave the 2026 months as they are, and the invoices with no date too.
hints: Run the starter and read the error: which column does it say the condition may use?
OPTIMIZE picks whole partitions, so its condition can only use the partition column, `invoice_month`.
`invoice_month` is text like `2025-12`. Compare it with text of the same shape: is `'2026-01' < '2026-01-01'` true?
explanation: OPTIMIZE compacts whole partitions, so `where` may only use partition columns, and `invoice_date` isn't one: Delta stops with an error that names it. The same months are `invoice_month < '2026-01'`, because months written as `yyyy-MM` sort as text in date order. Comparing with `'2026-01-01'` looks right but isn't: `'2026-01'` is a prefix of it, so it sorts before it and January 2026 would be compacted too. A missing date gives a NULL month, and a comparison with NULL is never true, so that partition is left alone.
